title: Four Young Boys Standing Together, 1948 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A clear black and white vintage snapshot showing four young boys lined up with their arms around one another, posing outside a building constructed with brick and glass blocks. Dated July 5, 1948 on the reverse, the image captures post-WWII era youth clothing trends, including high-waisted pleated trousers, patterned knit shirts, and casual collared button-downs.
